job.value: review listings and act on them (promote, see insights)

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: Title 'Manage listings', 'Search your listings' and tabs '9999 Active / Inactive / Others' make the purpose clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: An outlined 'Promote' and a green 'View insights' repeat on every card, so no single action leads and each pair competes card by card.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Promote' and 'View insights' are clear, but the circle at each photo's top right (select?) and the 'Others' tab don't say what they do or hold.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: The lightning icon and the purple badge on some photos have no label, and 'Others' doesn't name which listings it holds.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Only search, filter and per-listing actions the seller can decide on now.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Insights are a link per card, not shown inline.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is for a seller managing their own listings.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Cards carry photo, title, price and likes; no explanatory text.
